name: chattering-runtime
description: The Pi runtime Chattering is tested with; the WebRTC component phones connect through (node-datachannel, design/85); and the terminal agents' own programs run on (@lydell/node-pty: Microsoft's node-pty published compiled for Linux, macOS and Windows; @xterm/headless and its serializer: VS Code's terminal engine, design/91). All ship in its downloads. npm ci here installs exactly the locked versions.
